Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_ReturnEmptyCa: Return an empty capsule or Pal Sphere
When on, the player who threw a capsule gets an empty one of the same type back once the vehicle is out, and a Pal Sphere that released its animal comes back empty, same tier, ready to use again.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_PackPermissio:
With Minidoracat Vehicle Manager installed, a claimed vehicle can only be packed by its owner and by players the owner shared Tow with (admins need its override on); this option covers unclaimed vehicles.
Key holders: the player carries this vehicle's key, or the key is in the ignition.
Anyone: every player can pack.
Admins only: regular players cannot pack.
Admins can always pack, whatever this option says.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_ZombieSoundRa: Zombie attraction radius of the capsule sound (tiles)
0 to 50 tiles. 0 means the capsule popping open does not attract zombies.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_AllowCargoTak: Allow taking cargo out of capsules

When on, players can take cargo out of a loaded capsule without unpacking the vehicle. Items can only be taken out, never put in. A freshly packed capsule opens after about 5 seconds; a capsule left unconfirmed by a server crash stays locked.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_RecordRetenti:
1 to 90 days. Records of capsules that were unpacked, restored or voided are deleted once their last event is older than this. Packed and unconfirmed records are always kept: they are needed to restore what was packed.
Records live on the server in Zomboid/Lua/MinidoracatCapsule/, one folder per world; back them up with the world save.

Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_AllowAnimals_: When on, players can catch any live animal in the world (wild or tame, young or grown) in a Pal Sphere, from the animal's menu or by throwing an empty one. Off only stops catching animals: Pal Spheres that already hold one can still release it, and admins can restore it.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_WildCaptureCh: Base chance, in percent, that catching a wild animal works, from the animal's menu or by throwing a Pal Sphere. The final chance is this base plus the sphere tier bonus and the three bonuses below, at most 100. On a miss the animal breaks free and stays where it is, and the Pal Sphere is not used up (a thrown one falls where it landed). 0: wild animals can't be caught (no bonus brings them back); 100: always works. Tame animals are not affected. With "Pal Sphere lost on a failed catch" on, a miss takes the sphere too.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_WildCaptureFa: Pal Sphere lost on a failed catch

When on, a wild animal that breaks free on the catch roll also takes the empty Pal Sphere: from the animal's menu it is removed from the inventory, and a thrown one does not fall where it landed. Only a failed roll counts; any other miss (the target ran off, the spot is blocked and so on) keeps the sphere. Tame animals are not affected.
